notes.title: Update patch 1.3.12: stability fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We just launched update 1.3.12, which should address the following:

-In-game crashes
-Lost audio in extended play sessions
-Various cosmetic and other issues

Definitely let us know if you run across any issues with this patch! The main remaining issue is a startup problem on some systems which we have not been able to reproduce yet, but is our top priority right now.

Thank you all for the kind words on the game, we hope you enjoy it as much as we do!

Cheers,

Francois
Empty Clip Studios
